[FACT] User is having trouble adjusting to a new wake-up time since the clocks fell back.  
[CHANGE] User used to wake up at 7:00 am before the clocks fell back.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Setting a smart alarm on a phone can help wake up feeling more refreshed and energized.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For Android Devices:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Download and install a sleep tracking app (e.g., Google Fit, Sleep Cycle, or Pillow).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Open Google Fit and enable sleep tracking by tapping the "+" icon and selecting "Sleep."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Set up sleep tracking by granting permission to access the phone's accelerometer and microphone.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Set a smart alarm by tapping the "Alarms" tab and creating a new alarm, choosing "Smart Alarm."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Configure the smart alarm to wake up during a light sleep phase and set a time window (e.g., 30 minutes).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For iOS Devices:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Download and install a sleep tracking app (e.g., Sleep Cycle, Pillow, or AutoSleep).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Open Sleep Cycle and create an account or log in.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Set up sleep tracking by following in-app instructions and granting necessary permissions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Set a smart alarm by tapping the "Alarm" tab and creating a new alarm, choosing "Smart Alarm."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Configure the smart alarm to wake up during light sleep and set a time window (e.g., 30 minutes).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for using sleep tracking apps:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Place your phone on your bed near your pillow for accurate tracking.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Use the app consistently for a few days before setting a smart alarm.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Adjust alarm window and sensitivity settings to your liking.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Consider a gentle, gradual wake-up sequence.
